2610.02704.title: Label-Efficient Time Series Classification at Scale: A Dual-Stream OSSE-LSTM with Counterfactual Attribution
2610.02704.paper_summary: Time series are produced continuously at enormous scale by industrial equipment, wearables, power grids, and clinical monitors, yet annotation remains manual, expensive, and expert-dependent. The binding constraint in large-scale time series analytics is therefore not data volume but label volume, and the question facing a practitioner is concrete: how many examples per class must be labeled before a classifier becomes usable? We study this question directly, in a regime where the label space is fixed and known in advance and the decision rule must be constructed from only K labeled examples per class. We propose Dual-Stream OSSE-LSTM, an episodic metric-learning framework that pairs an Omni-Scale CNN with Squeeze-and-Excitation recalibration, for multi-scale motif extraction without per-dataset kernel tuning, with a Bidirectional LSTM for global temporal context. The two streams are independently normalized and fused into a prototype-oriented embedding. Because decisions taken from a few labels must also be explainable, we introduce Counterfactual Integrated Gradients (C-IG), which attributes the prototype margin between target and opposing classes rather than an isolated classifier logit, and reuses the resulting maps as soft masks for test-time prototype refinement without updating the encoder. On 19 univariate UCR datasets, OSSE-LSTM attains the highest average accuracy and per-dataset win count at every support size, and its accuracy remains within a 0.36-point band (96.36-96.72%) across that range. Its weakest configuration still exceeding the best result any compared baseline achieves at any K (93.99%).
2610.02704.paper_summary_zh: 時間序列由工業設備、可穿戴設備、電力網絡和臨床監測器持續以巨大的規模產生，但標註仍然是手動的、昂貴的，並且依賴專家。因此，在大規模時間序列分析中，限制因素不是數據量，而是標籤量，面對從業者的問題是具體的：每個類別必須標註多少示例，分類器才能變得可用？我們直接研究這個問題，在標籤空間固定且事先已知的情況下，決策規則必須僅從每個類別的 K 個標註示例中構建。我們提出了雙流 OSSE-LSTM，一種情節度量學習框架，將 Omni-Scale CNN 與 Squeeze-and-Excitation 再校準配對，用於多尺度模式提取，而無需針對每個數據集進行內核調整，並使用雙向 LSTM 來獲取全局時間上下文。這兩個流獨立正規化並融合成一個原型導向的嵌入。由於從少數標籤中做出的決策也必須是可解釋的，我們引入了反事實集成梯度（C-IG），它將目標類別和對立類別之間的原型邊際歸因，而不是孤立的分類器邏輯，並重用結果圖作為測試時間原型精煉的軟掩碼，而無需更新編碼器。在 19 個單變量 UCR 數據集上，OSSE-LSTM 在每個支持大小上達到最高的平均準確率和每個數據集的勝利數，並且其準確率在該範圍內保持在 0.36 點的帶內（96.36-96.72%）。其最弱的配置仍然超過任何 K 的比較基線所達到的最佳結果（93.99%）。
